title: Symrise AG announces Chief Financial Officer transition and extension of Walter Ribeiro’s Executive Board appointment
summary: – Martin Huber to succeed Olaf Klinger as Chief Financial Officer of Symrise AG as part of a planned succession – Olaf Klinger will conclude his successful eleven-year tenure at Symrise AG on March 31, 2027 – Martin Huber will assume the position of CFO at Symrise AG on April 1, 2027, bringing more than 20 years of international finance and leadership experience – Walter Ribeiro’s Executive Board mandate as President Taste, Nutrition & Health extended by an additional four years until September 19, 2031

extraction.key_fact: Symrise AG의 최고재무책임자가 계획된 승계에 따라 Olaf Klinger에서 Martin Huber로 바뀐다.
